question: In a high school with \(500\) students, \(40\%\) of the seniors play a musical instrument, while \(30\%\) of the non-seniors do not play a musical instrument. In all, \(46.8\%\) of the students do not play a musical instrument. How many non-seniors play a musical instrument?
solution:
Count students who do not play an instrument, since the overall percentage describes that group. Because \(40\%\) of seniors play, \(60\%\) of seniors do not play.

Let \(n\) be the number of non-seniors. There are then \(500-n\) seniors. Adding the nonplayers from both groups gives
\[
0.60(500-n)+0.30n=0.468\cdot500=234.
\]
Simplifying,
\[
300-0.30n=234,
\qquad
0.30n=66,
\qquad
n=220.
\]
Since \(30\%\) of non-seniors do not play, the other \(70\%\) do. Their number is
\[
0.70\cdot220=154.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{154}\), choice \(\text{(B)}\).
